# Pega Cloud for Government Achieves GovRAMP Impact High Level Status


New authorization helps state and local governments accelerate procurement and deployment with confidence


**WALTHAM, Mass. – November 10, 2026 –**[Pegasystems Inc.](https://www.pega.com/) (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, today announced[Pega Cloud® for Government](https://www.pega.com/industries/government/cloud) has achieved GovRAMP Impact High Level status, the highest designation available from this emerging government technology certification program. This provides state and local government clients with independent validation that Pega meets rigorous cloud security and risk management requirements, helping local agencies more quickly procure and deploy it.


**Market context: Helping state and local governments move to the cloud**
State and local government organizations are modernizing legacy systems and moving more critical operations to the cloud while facing stringent requirements to protect government data. These security requirements can add time and complexity to cloud procurement as agencies assess whether technology providers meet their standards. Similar to FedRAMP for federal agencies,[GovRAMP](https://govramp.org/) provides a standardized approach for validating each jurisdiction’s cloud security requirements, giving participating government organizations greater confidence when evaluating cloud services.


**A Closer Look: Validated for stringent security requirements**
To achieve GovRAMP Impact Level High, Pega underwent a comprehensive independent assessment of its security, operational, and compliance practices. The process evaluated controls across areas including access management, data protection, vulnerability management, incident response, continuous monitoring, and risk management.


Pega Cloud for Government provides the workflow automation tools, environments, and operational support government agencies use to modernize applications and improve operations. It connects data and systems across operational silos to help reduce complexity and improve service delivery, while giving agencies the flexibility to scale as requirements change. Pega Cloud for Government is also FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified, the program’s highest security level, for federal workloads involving sensitive data.


**Availability: How to Get Pega Cloud for Government**
Pega Cloud for Government is now available with GovRAMP certification to state and local governments. For more information, visit[www.pega.com/industries/government/cloud](http://www.pega.com/industries/government/cloud)


**Quotes & Commentary**
“An increasing number of state and local governments are requiring GovRAMP authorization as a prerequisite for adopting modern cloud technology,” said Doug Averill, vice president, global industry market leader, government, Pega. “Pega Cloud for Government’s authorization provides independent validation of its security controls and a more direct path to procurement and deployment. This opens the door for more agencies to use Pega to modernize their operations and better serve their constituents.
